planned_arguments.prompt:
Edit only this own returned poster into one complete flat opaque 16:9 landscape poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Observed defects to correct: the slogan is printed twice, with a large central copy wrongly replacing the invitation as the main anchor; the invitation and URL are small at the lower right; paragraph and visit details are too small in the 720-wide view; an extra separator dot appears between date and hours; the care view is tall and takes away caption width.

Rebuild that central caption relationship while retaining the three substantive painted experiences, rectilinear editorial sequence and botanical attachments. Make the upper market panorama shallower, about one quarter of the poster height, and the left window-leaf view slightly narrower while still tall and full of convincing overlapping living leaves. Make the right care view an actual compact square, preserving the rooted plant being held above the open pot and the clear hand/rim contact. This should open a considerably wider uninterrupted central caption, not reduce it to a tiny footer. Fill every image interior with botanical or pottery forms. Keep the views unequal, related and unnumbered.

Replace the present huge central slogan with this invitation, set as two natural phrase lines in a warm medium-weight Korean serif. This is the dominant copy and the immediate start of the descending paragraph:
편하게 들러
천천히 둘러보세요.
Remove its previous lower-right instance so the invitation appears once.

Retain the slogan only in the quiet lower-left identity group beside the Korean title and Latin companion:
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
Remove its large central duplicate. The left identity remains quieter than the invitation.

Immediately under the central invitation, keep the entire existing supplied explanation verbatim, on a stable shared left edge, in the same four meaningful line groups. Enlarge its mature Korean sans body, balanced square syllables, generous counters and normal word spaces for a comfortable roughly 15–17-pixel apparent body at a 720-pixel-wide view. This is a display-planning assumption, not a requested output size. Plain precise planar typesetting, no brush texture on text. Use broader caption width and reduced picture height to fit it, rather than shrinking the words.

One short downward step from the final paragraph line leads locally to the existing market name, slightly stronger than prose but weaker than invitation. Date and hours follow together in a local row, venue immediately below. Keep the access and care-offer lines together below that, and move the existing URL directly after those lines on the same caption axis. All details need substantial clear body and easy reading at 720-wide. Preserve every original glyph and meaningful space. The exact range/date and hours are:
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
Use extended midline en-dash shapes distinct from a short hyphen, preserve colons and periods. Remove the added separator dot BETWEEN the two entries; use spacing to distinguish them. Keep the supplied middle dots within their entries. No new separator punctuation.

Retain all twelve supplied copy entries exactly once, including the complete explanation, the original market name, venue, access, care offer and URL. No rewriting, duplication, new words, labels, pot lettering, logo, watermark or QR. Keep the original quieter two-line Korean identity and its Latin companion together at the tall view's lower edge.

Strengthen the assigned painterly expression: broad opaque gouache/oil masses with controlled bristle edges, deep indigo and plum shadows, luminous varied leaf greens and selective honey window light. Retain convincing stems, roots, pot rims, bases, hands and contact. Use painterly form decisions rather than a photograph with a uniform filter. Keep typography flat and precise despite rough imagery.

This is one coherent image-led editorial poster with three legitimate content scenes, not a comparison sheet, contact sheet, mockup or extra poster. Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate tiny imagery, texture/font substitutions or empty-room text boards. Protect the unequal image sequence, central invitation → full explanation → visit/care/URL route and quieter left identity.

own_observed_repair_cause: Duplicate slogan and reversed central invitation hierarchy
Small explanation and visit bodies at usage720
Tall care view reduces caption width
maintained_features: Substantive window life, market selection and rooted repotting scenes
Exact twelve client entries, normal word spaces and optical punctuation
Convincing botanical attachments, roots and pot structure
